newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: TransAsia sets 705.6 mln pesos for projects.
newsitem.headline: TransAsia sets 705.6 mln pesos for projects.

text.p: TransAsia Oil and Mineral Development Corp said on Monday it had earmarked 705.6 million pesos to finance projects to be undertaken between June 1997 and August 1998.

Assistant vice-president Ponciano Dimayuga told the Securities and Exchange Commission that the capital outlay is part of the 1.025 billion peso programme set for the 1995/96 to 1997/98 financial years.
The company operates on a financial period starting in September.

Major items to be financed between June to August this year include eight oil exploration projects in the Philippines and abroad, two property developments and a waterworks supply. The company has earmarked 154.45 million pesos for these projects.
For 1997/98 financial year, a total of 551.19 million pesos would be spent, of which 320 million pesos has been earmarked for a power project to be built inside a cement plant north of Manila.
TransAsia said it would raise funds from stock rights, stock option plans, internally generated funds and borrowings.
